name: Heirloom
idea: A Moldovan carpet rhombus with ram's-horn hooks and a parcel-shaped eye at its heart, built only from cross-stitches (every stitch is an X), with CNX stitched on the same grid.
why: It looks like the embroidery on every Moldovan towel and blouse, so it reads as ours at a glance, and the stitch grid becomes a whole system: tape borders, embroidered jackets and a crisp 1-bit label print.
risks: Folk ornament can feel handmade rather than fast, and the lacy horn hooks fill in below about 32 px, so small uses should rely on the solid crimson tile icon.
